Read LogPhase600 text export

read_logphase_txt.Rd

Reads a text file exported from a LogPhase600 plate reader. The file has a header block (procedure summary) followed by a line starting with Time and the well names, and then one row per read. The header block is located automatically.

Usage

read_logphase_txt(
  path,
  interval_hours = 1/3,
  thin_hours = NULL,
  encoding = "latin1"
)

Arguments

path

Path to the text file.

interval_hours

Nominal read interval in hours, passed to snap_hours(). Default is 20 minutes (1/3). Use NULL to keep the reported times.

thin_hours

Optional coarser read interval in hours, for example 1 to keep one read per hour. Thinning happens after times are snapped to the interval_hours grid, keeps only reads that fall on the coarser grid, and requires interval_hours to be set and thin_hours to be a whole multiple of it. NULL (default) keeps every read.

encoding

File encoding. Defaults to "latin1", which these exports use (the header contains a degree sign).

Value

A tibble with columns seconds, hours, well, od and plate_id. plate_id is taken from the Plate Number line of the header (for example "Plate 1"), matching the sheet names in the Excel export. If that line is missing, the file name without its extension is used.

Details

Time is made relative to the first read and snapped to a regular grid with snap_hours() so that replicate plates line up exactly. Well ids are zero-padded (A1 becomes A01).

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "logphase600_example.txt", package = "plateReadeR")
read_logphase_txt(f)
#> # A tibble: 1,152 × 5
#>    seconds hours well     od plate_id
#>      <dbl> <dbl> <chr> <dbl> <chr>   
#>  1       0 0     A01   0.116 Plate 1 
#>  2    1200 0.333 A01   0.116 Plate 1 
#>  3    2400 0.667 A01   0.116 Plate 1 
#>  4    3600 1     A01   0.117 Plate 1 
#>  5    4800 1.33  A01   0.117 Plate 1 
#>  6    6000 1.67  A01   0.118 Plate 1 
#>  7    7200 2     A01   0.119 Plate 1 
#>  8    8400 2.33  A01   0.119 Plate 1 
#>  9    9600 2.67  A01   0.119 Plate 1 
#> 10   10800 3     A01   0.119 Plate 1 
#> # ℹ 1,142 more rows
